name: TeamBox E2E — All Channels
description: End-to-end TeamBox verification after comms tests have generated conversations. All inbound types visible, outbound reply works, Take Over cycle, kill switch queue, VAPI/Tavus logs with transcripts, channel/status filters functional.
acceptanceCriteria: T-018.AC1: SMS conversations from T-017a/b visible in TeamBox
T-018.AC2: Voice conversations from T-017a/b visible in TeamBox with transcripts
T-018.AC3: Form submission conversations from T-014 visible in TeamBox
T-018.AC4: Outbound reply from TeamBox → delivery confirmed in outbound_log
T-018.AC5: Take Over cycle: assign human → AI stops → un-assign → AI resumes
T-018.AC6: Kill switch queue: CommGate OFF → send → queued in TeamBox → ON → released
T-018.AC7: Phone tab shows VAPI call logs with working transcript links
T-018.AC8: Video tab shows Tavus session logs
T-018.AC9: Channel filter chips functional (click SMS → only SMS conversations shown)
T-018.AC10: Status filters functional (click automated → only automated shown)
method: Playwright MCP — verifies conversations generated by T-017a/b
